classes.name: Acrobat
classes.weapons: Missile weapons, dagger,  sword, short sword, polearm, spear, staff
features: Evasion: retreating negates the usual enemy +2 attack bonus.
Tumbling attack: double damage; +4 to hit an unaware enemy.
Jumping, falling and tightrope abilities require movement at least 90 feet.

classes.name: Assassin
features: Assassination: +4 attack from behind against an unaware eligible humanoid; death save penalty follows skill table.
Disguise: base detection chance 2%; see p. 30 for modifiers.
Poison: victim saves at -2. Hireling access depends on level.

classes.name: Barbarian
features: Cannot read or write at first level. Avoids arcane magic.
Forage 2-in-6; find prey when hunting 5-in-6.
Cure poison: wilderness herbal antidote permits a second save.
Level 4: strike monsters otherwise harmed only by magic; agile AC bonus begins.

classes.name: Bard
features: Anti-charm: music protects allies within 30 feet against song magic and sylvan beguilement.
Enchantment: noncombat fascination; 2 HD of subjects per level, save versus spells.
Level 2: druidic spellcasting and lore 2-in-6.
Even levels from 4: learn an additional language.

classes.name: Cleric
features: Turn undead: use the level-based table; roll 2d6, then 2d6 HD affected on success.
Level 2: clerical spellcasting begins.
Must carry a holy symbol and uphold deity obligations.

classes.name: Drow
features: Use this race-as-class’s complete abilities on the referenced class pages; racial saves are already included in its progression.

classes.name: Druid
features: Fire and lightning saves +2; identify plants, animals and pure water.
Secret druidic language. Woodlands: party gets lost only on 1-in-6.
Level 3: pass without trace; a sylvan language each level from 3.
Level 7: sylvan charm immunity and shape change. Level 12+ requires a challenge.

classes.name: Duergar
features: Use this race-as-class’s complete abilities on the referenced class pages; racial saves are already included in its progression.

classes.name: Dwarf
features: Construction tricks and room traps 2-in-6; listen 2-in-6.
Infravision 60 feet; small weapon restrictions. Racial resilience is already in the class save table.

classes.name: Elf
features: Secret doors 2-in-6 when searching; listen 2-in-6. Infravision 60 feet.
Ghoul paralysis immunity. Arcane spells use a standard spell book.

classes.name: Fighter
features: All weapons, armour and shields permitted.
Stronghold construction is possible with sufficient wealth.

classes.name: Gnome
features: Use this race-as-class’s complete abilities on the referenced class pages; racial saves are already included in its progression.
languages: the secret language of burrowing mammals

classes.name: Half-Elf
features: Use this race-as-class’s complete abilities on the referenced class pages; racial saves are already included in its progression.

classes.name: Halfling
classes.armor: Any appropriate to size,  including shields
features: Hiding while still: wilderness cover 90%, dungeon cover 2-in-6.
Listen 2-in-6; missile attacks +1; individual initiative +1.
AC improves by 2 against larger-than-human foes. Resilience is already in the class save table.

classes.name: Half-Orc
features: Use this race-as-class’s complete abilities on the referenced class pages; racial saves are already included in its progression.

classes.name: Illusionist
features: Standard spell book: capacity equals spells memorized at each spell level.
Cannot use magic items that deal direct damage.

classes.name: Knight
features: Must follow the liege’s alignment and chivalric code.
Mounted attack rolls +1. Immune to supernatural fear.
Saves versus beguilement +4; illusions +2; may save against sleep.
Level 3: hospitality and fear protection for nearby companions.

classes.name: Magic-User
features: Standard spell book: capacity equals spells memorized at each spell level.
At first level, one spell selected with referee approval.

classes.name: Paladin
features: Lawful only; disease immunity.
Laying on hands: heal 2 HP per level once daily.
Donate 10% of income; magical possessions limited by vow.
Level 3: turn undead. Level 4: holy warhorse. Level 9: cleric spells.

classes.name: Ranger
features: Surprised only on 1. Forage 2-in-6; find prey 5-in-6.
Wilderness hide and move silently: 3-in-6 each.
Tracking starts at 20%, improves 10% per level to 110%; situational modifiers apply.
Pursued enemy evasion chance -10%. Level 8: druidic spells.

classes.name: Svirfneblin
classes.armor: Any appropriate to size, in- cluding shields
features: Use this race-as-class’s complete abilities on the referenced class pages; racial saves are already included in its progression.

classes.name: Thief
features: Back-stab: unaware enemy from behind, +4 attack and double damage.
Level 4: read nonmagical languages 80%. Level 10: arcane scroll use with 10% error.

races.name: Human
features: No racial abilities under standard restrictions.

races.name: Drow
features: Secret doors 2-in-6 when searching; listen 2-in-6.
Immune to ghoul paralysis. Bright light: attacks -2 and AC worsens by 1.
Level 2: darkness once daily. Level 4: detect magic once daily.

races.name: Duergar
features: Construction tricks and room traps 2-in-6; listen 2-in-6.
Underground move silently 3-in-6. Bright light: attacks -2 and AC worsens by 1.
CON-based resilience applies to poison, paralysis and magic saves.

races.name: Dwarf
features: Construction tricks and room traps 2-in-6; listen 2-in-6.
CON-based resilience applies to poison and magic saves.

races.name: Elf
features: Secret doors 2-in-6 when searching; listen 2-in-6.
Immune to ghoul paralysis.

races.name: Gnome
languages: the secret language of burrowing mammals
features: AC improves by 2 against larger-than-human foes. Construction tricks 2-in-6; listen 2-in-6.
CON-based resistance applies to magic saves; speak with burrowing mammals.

races.name: Half-Elf
features: Secret doors 2-in-6 when searching.

races.name: Halfling
features: AC improves by 2 against larger-than-human foes. Listen 2-in-6.
Missile attacks +1. Individual initiative +1. CON-based poison and magic resilience.

races.name: Svirfneblin
features: AC improves by 2 against larger-than-human foes; saves against illusions +2.
Blend with stone: 4-in-6 in gloom, 2-in-6 in light when still and silent.
Construction tricks 2-in-6; listen 2-in-6. Speak with earth elementals.
Bright light: attacks -2 and AC worsens by 1.
